entities.summary: The Cathedral of Our Lady of Nahuel Huapi Also Cathedral of Carlos de Bariloche is the main Catholic cathedral within the city of San Carlos de Bariloche, in Patagonia Argentina. It is located on large plot of land close to the Nahuel Huapi Lake, surrounded by beautiful gardens, and is within the Diocese of Bariloche, suffragan of the Archdiocese of Bahía Blanca.
